snippet.title: MMOS: MMO Simulator Official Trailer
snippet.description:
MMOS: MMO Simulator is a management sim where you run a living MMORPG, and your players are thousands of autonomous adventurers with their own goals, wallets, and breaking points. They roll classes, grind levels, chase loot, form guilds, raid your dungeons, undercut each other on the auction house, and pay you a subscription to play.

Build a world worth subscribing to, then keep them logged in and keep them paying.

It's RollerCoaster tycoon with an MMORPG twist.

PLAY THE DEMO HERE:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4926510/MMOS_MMO_Simulator_Demo/

WISHLIST ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4873130/MMOS_MMO_Simulator

Steam Release: 11th December 2026
----------------------------------------

WHAT YOU DO:
- Sculpt the map: terrain, water and lava, roads, flight paths, towns and cities
- Author the content: quests, loot tables, gear, classes, professions, mounts and more!
- Create dungeons, raids, arenas and battlegrounds for your players to enjoy
- Stock the economy: vendors, trainers and auction houses
- Tune every dial: sub price, fares, vendor margins, dungeon difficulty

WHAT THEY DO:
- Every adventurer is simulated, not scripted
- They act on who they are: raiders, gatherers, gold-flippers, explorers
- They make friends and rivals, form parties and guilds, and remember how you treat them
- Set the price too high and your whales tolerate it while everyone else churns

----------------------------------------

FOLLOW THE GAME:
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4873130/MMOS_MMO_Simulator
- itch.io: https://bmodev.itch.io/mmos-mmo-simulator-demo
